title: The Lion Child
overview: In the village of Pama, Sirga the lioness and Oule the young boy, born the same day, grow up together as sister and brother. Oule discovers the world alongside Sirga, and it is through her that he learns the secrets of the brush. He knows how to speak to the trees, the beasts, the bees and the wind. But one day, horsemen arrive from the Nord to take away all of the children of the village in chains and sell them into slavery. Oule and his friend Lena are bought by a nobleman of the high plains who, terrified by Oule's powers, sends him into exile. But Oule posesses the strength of lions and he finds Sirga. With Lena, they will reconstruct the village of Pama...

title: Watch Where the River Divides
overview: After his baptism, the son of a Kenyan clan leader returns to his village and must choose between inheriting his father's legacy and following a new purpose that could cost him his life. Based on a true story.
tagline: A true story of legacy, faith, and courage.

title: My Father's Shadow
overview: Two young brothers explore Lagos with their estranged father during the 1993 Nigerian election crisis, witnessing both the city's magnitude and their father's daily struggles as political unrest threatens their journey home.

title: Gang Tapes
overview: When a brutal carjacking yields a videocamera, a teenage boy decides to document his life and the lives of his fellow gangbangers.
tagline: A coming of Rage story

title: Happy Together
overview: A couple travels from Hong Kong to Argentina to revive their relationship but experience turbulence when both men's lives drift in separate directions.
tagline: Lonely people are all the same.

title: Belly
overview: Tommy Bundy and Sincere are best friends as well as infamous and ruthless criminals and shot-callers in the hood. Respected by many but feared by all.  As the police are closing in on them and new players are looking for a come up, will their reign last?
tagline: Money, power, respect... but who's got your back?

title: Korn's Password
overview: An intelligence agent's murder bring upon a national investigation into a spy organisation called Korn.

title: Touki Bouki
overview: Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.
tagline: The Journey of the Hyena.

title: The Broken Mirror
overview: Anne lives with her husband in Belgium where she works as a restorer of paintings. When she becomes pregnant, she finds herself remembering a picture she did some time ago and of which she has no memory, no recollection of what happened to it. It becomes her goal to discover and clarify the mystery behind this painting, at the same time she notices that a strange man is following all of her moves.

title: Mother of George
overview: A Nigerian couple living in Brooklyn are having trouble conceiving a child - a problem that defies cultural expectations and leads to a shocking decision that could either save or destroy them.

title: Blue Is the Warmest Color
overview: Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire, to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adele grows, seeks herself, loses herself, finds herself.
tagline: To love.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
overview: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.
tagline: No dream is ever just a dream.

title: Chungking Express
overview: Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal server at a late-night restaurant.
tagline: If my memory of her has an expiration date, let it be 10,000 years...

title: Barry Lyndon
overview: An Irish rogue uses his cunning and wit to work his way up the social classes of 18th century England, transforming himself from the humble Redmond Barry into the noble Barry Lyndon.
Women enter and exit a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years after the author loses the woman he considers his one true love.
tagline: Are you still in the mood for love?

title: Stalker
overview: Near a gray and unnamed city is the Zone, a place guarded by barbed wire and soldiers, and where the normal laws of physics are victim to frequent anomalies. A stalker guides two men into the Zone, specifically to an area in which deep-seated desires are granted.
tagline: There's no need to speak. You must only...concentrate and recall all your past life. When a man thinks of the past, he becomes kinder.

title: Fallen Angels
overview: An indifferent hitman, his infatuated business partner and an ex-convict search for love and meaning as their lives cross paths in Hong Kong.
tagline: The night's full of weirdos.

cast_list.name: Wu Yuk-Ho
cast_list.character: Man Forced to Have His Clothes Washed

title: Visitor Q
overview: In a dysfunctional family where the mother is a heroin addict and prostitute, beaten by her son, and the father is an ex-TV reporter, sleeping with his daughter and filming his son being beaten up, ‘Q’, a complete stranger enters the bizarre family, changing their lives for the better, finding a balance in their disturbing natures.
tagline: The only thing stranger than this family is... Visitor Q.

title: 13 Assassins
overview: A bravado period action film set at the end of Japan's feudal era in which a group of unemployed samurai are enlisted to bring down a sadistic lord and prevent him from ascending to the throne and plunging the country into a war-torn future.
tagline: Take up your sword.

title: Ichi the Killer
overview: As sadomasochistic yakuza enforcer Kakihara searches for his missing boss he comes across Ichi, a repressed and psychotic killer who may be able to inflict levels of pain that Kakihara has only dreamed of.
tagline: Love really hurts.

title: In the Mood for Love
overview: In 1960s Hong Kong, two neighbors form an intimate bond after making a discovery about their spouses in this visually stunning tale of unrequited love.
tagline: Feel the heat, keep the feeling burning, let the sensation explode.

cast_list.name: Joe Cheung Tung-Cho
cast_list.character: Man Living in Mr. Koo's Apartment

title: Mysterious Skin
overview: A teenage hustler and a young man obsessed with alien abductions cross paths, together discovering a horrible, liberating truth.
tagline: Two boys. One can't remember. The other can't forget.

title: Nowhere
overview: In Los Angeles, a colorful assortment of bohemians try to make sense of their intersecting lives. The moody Dark Smith, his bisexual girlfriend, her lesbian lover and their shy gay friend plan on attending the wildest party of the year. But they'll only make it if they can survive the drug trips, suicides, trysts, mutilations and alien abductions that occur as one surreal day unfolds.
tagline: Let the love feast begin.

title: The Doom Generation
overview: Jordan White and Amy Blue, two troubled teens, pick up an adolescent drifter, Xavier Red. Together, the threesome embarks on a sex- and violence-filled journey through a United States of psychos and quickie marts.
tagline: Sex. Violence. Whatever.

title: Sinners
overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.
tagline: Dance with the devil.

title: Black Girl
overview: Eager to find a better life abroad, a Senegalese woman becomes a mere governess to a family in southern France, suffering from discrimination and marginalization.

title: The Tree of Life
overview: The impressionistic story of a Texas family in the 1950s. The film follows the life journey of the eldest son, Jack, through the innocence of childhood to his disillusioned adult years as he tries to reconcile a complicated relationship with his father. Jack finds himself a lost soul in the modern world, seeking answers to the origins and meaning of life while questioning the existence of faith.
tagline: Nothing stands still.

title: Obsession
overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
tagline: Be careful who you wish for…

title: Whiplash
overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.
tagline: Do your best, he said…

title: Beyond Outrage
overview: As the police launch a full-scale crackdown on organized crime, it ignites a national yakuza struggle between the Sanno of the East and Hanabishi of the West. What started as an internal strife in Outrage has now become a nationwide war in Outrage Beyond.
tagline: Who is the worst among them?

title: Takeshis'
overview: Beat Takeshi lives the busy and sometimes surreal life of a showbiz celebrity. One day he meets his blond lookalike named Kitano, a shy convenience store cashier, who, still an unknown actor, is waiting for his big break. After their paths cross, Kitano seems to begin hallucinating about becoming Beat.
tagline: 500% Kitano - nothing to add!

cast_list.name: Kayoko Kishimoto
cast_list.character: Mahjong Parlor Woman / Audition Producer / Costumer

cast_list.name: Tetsu Watanabe
cast_list.character: TV Wardrobe Master / Noodle Cook / Audition Actor

cast_list.name: Koichi Ueda
cast_list.character: Film Crew Member close to the Director

title: Dolls
overview: Dolls takes puppeteering as its overriding motif, which relates thematically to the action provided by the live characters. Chief among those tales is the story of Matsumoto and Sawako, a young couple whose relationship is about to be broken apart by the former's parents, who have insisted their son take part in an arranged marriage to his boss' daughter.
tagline: Three stories of never-ending love.

title: Brother
overview: A Japanese Yakuza gangster's deadly existence in his homeland gets him exiled to Los Angeles, where he is taken in by his little brother and his brother's gang.
tagline: Are You Japanese?

title: Pina
overview: Pina is a feature-length dance film in 3D with the ensemble of the Tanztheater Wuppertal Pina Bausch, featuring the unique and inspiring art of the great German choreographer, who died in the summer of 2009.
tagline: Dance, dance, otherwise we are lost.

feed_key: Enter The Void Uncut - Fantasy Mystery|2009
title: Enter the Void
overview: This psychedelic tour of life after death is seen entirely from the point of view of Oscar, a young American drug dealer and addict living in Tokyo with his prostitute sister, Linda. When Oscar is killed by police during a bust gone bad, his spirit journeys from the past -- where he sees his parents before their deaths -- to the present -- where he witnesses his own autopsy -- and then to the future, where he looks out for his sister from beyond the grave.

title: Waves
overview: A controlling father’s attempts to ensure that his two children succeed in high school backfire after his son experiences a career-ending sports injury. Their familial bonds are eventually placed under severe strain by an unexpected tragedy.
tagline: Love is patient.

title: mid90s
overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.
tagline: fall. get back up.

title: Suspiria
overview: A darkness swirls at the center of a world-renowned dance company, one that will engulf the artistic director, an ambitious young dancer, and a grieving psychotherapist. Some will succumb to the nightmare. Others will finally wake up.
tagline: Give your soul to the dance.

cast_list.name: Tilda Swinton
cast_list.character: Madame Blanc / Dr. Klemperer / Helena Markos

title: Frank
overview: A young wannabe musician discovers he has bitten off more than he can chew when he joins an eccentric pop band led by the mysterious and enigmatic Frank.
tagline: When you think you've gone far enough, go farther.

title: One Battle After Another
overview: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.
tagline: Some search for battle, others are born into it...

title: Paris, Texas
overview: A man wanders out of the desert not knowing who he is. His brother finds him, and helps to pull his memory back of the life he led before he walked out on his family and disappeared four years earlier.
tagline: A place for dreams. A place for heartbreak. A place to pick up the pieces.

title: Eyimofe (This Is My Desire)
overview: A man and a woman in Lagos want to escape their everyday lives, but extricating themselves is no easy task. Two stories narrated with tenderness and restraint that only fleetingly touch, the dream of migrating to Europe floating above them all the while.
tagline: You have a dream. Life has other plans.

title: Zatoichi
overview: Blind traveler Zatoichi is a master swordsman and a masseur with a fondness for gambling on dice games. When he arrives in a village torn apart by warring gangs, he sets out to protect the townspeople.
tagline: His sword made him a hero... his courage made him a legend.

title: Love Actually
overview: Eight very different couples deal with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London.
tagline: Love actually is all around.

title: The Smashing Machine
overview: In the late 1990s, up-and-coming mixed martial artist Mark Kerr aspires to become the greatest fighter in the world. However, he must also battle his opioid dependence and a volatile relationship with his girlfriend Dawn.
tagline: The unforgettable true story of a UFC legend.

feed_key: Portrait Of A Lady On Fire|2019
title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
overview: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.
tagline: Don't regret. Remember.

title: Bugonia
overview: Two conspiracy obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.
tagline: Of all the abductions, this one is different.

title: Before Sunset
overview: Nine years later, Jesse travels across Europe giving readings from a book he wrote about the night he spent in Vienna with Celine. After his reading in Paris, Celine finds him, and they spend part of the day together before Jesse has to again leave for a flight. They are both in relationships now, and Jesse has a son, but as their strong feelings for each other start to return, both confess a longing for more.
tagline: What if you had a second chance with the one that got away?

title: Before Sunrise
overview: An unexpected meeting on a train leads two travelers to spend an evening wandering through Vienna. As the night unfolds, they share stories and conversations about life and love, exploring new ideas while a quiet intimacy grows between them, knowing it may be their only night together.
tagline: Can the greatest romance of your life last only one night?

title: Before Midnight
overview: It has been nine years since we last met Jesse and Celine, the French-American couple who once met on a train in Vienna. They now live in Paris with twin daughters but have spent a summer in Greece at the invitation of an author colleague of Jesse's. When the vacation is over and Jesse must send his teenage son off to the States, he begins to question his life decisions, and his relationship with Celine is at risk.
tagline: Everything's better with maturity.

title: Fargo
overview: Jerry Lundegaard is a small-town Minnesota car salesman deeply in debt and willing to do almost anything to get out. Police chief Marge Gunderson discovers a string of violent crimes as Jerry's schemes spiral out of control.
tagline: A lot can happen in the middle of nowhere.

title: A Haunted House
overview: Malcolm and Kisha move into their dream home, but soon learn a demon also resides there. When Kisha becomes possessed, Malcolm - determined to keep his sex life on track - turns to a priest, a psychic, and a team of ghost-busters for help in this spoof of all the "found-footage/documentary style" films released in recent years.
tagline: This $*%! ain't paranormal.

title: Under the Skin
overview: A seductive stranger prowls the streets of Glasgow in search of prey: unsuspecting men who fall under her spell.

title: The Wailing
overview: A stranger arrives in a little village and soon after a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman is drawn into the incident and is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter.
tagline: Never be tempted.

title: The Place Beyond the Pines
overview: A motorcycle stunt rider considers committing a crime in order to provide for his wife and child, an act that puts him on a collision course with a cop-turned-politician.
tagline: One moment can change your life.

title: The Master
overview: Freddie, a volatile, heavy-drinking veteran who suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder, finds some semblance of a family when he stumbles onto the ship of Lancaster Dodd, the charismatic leader of a new "religion" he forms after World War II.

title: Snowpiercer
overview: In a future where a failed global-warming experiment kills off most life on the planet, a class system evolves aboard the Snowpiercer; a train that travels around the globe via a perpetual-motion engine.
tagline: Fight your way to the front.

title: Sirāt
overview: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.
tagline: This is the desert.

title: Punch-Drunk Love
overview: A socially awkward and volatile small business owner meets the love of his life after being threatened by a gang of scammers.
tagline: I have a love in my life. It makes me stronger than anything you can imagine.

title: Pulse
overview: In the immense city of Tokyo, the darkness of the afterlife lures some of its inhabitants desperately trying to escape the sadness and isolation of the modern world.
tagline: Do you want to meet a ghost?

title: Phantom Thread
overview: In 1950s London, a renowned dressmaker's meticulous lifestyle begins drastically changing as his relationship with his young muse intensifies.

title: Perfect Days
overview: Hirayama is content with his life as a toilet cleaner in Tokyo. Outside of his structured routine, he cherishes music on cassette tapes, books, and taking photos of trees. Through unexpected encounters, he reflects on finding beauty in the world.
tagline: In a world of fleeting moments, find the beauty that lasts.

title: Paprika
overview: Dr. Atsuko Chiba is a research psychologist who uses a device called the DC Mini to enter her patients' dreams, wherein she adopts the alter-ego "Paprika". When the device is stolen, she must stop rogue elements from merging the dream and waking worlds.
tagline: This is your brain on anime.

title: Marty Supreme
overview: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.
tagline: Dream big.

title: Koyaanisqatsi
overview: Takes us to locations all around the US and shows us the heavy toll that modern technology is having on humans and the earth. The visual tone poem contains neither dialogue nor a vocalized narration: its tone is set by the juxtaposition of images and the exceptional music by Philip Glass.
tagline: Life out of balance

title: It Was Just an Accident
overview: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.

title: Hamnet
overview: The powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.
tagline: Keep your heart open.
